Report of the Inter-Ministerial
Committee on NER
1184. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the report of
the Inter-Ministerial Committee on the
North-Eastern States has recommended that
the Planning Commission should rationalise
the allocation of funds on the basis of
poverty ratio between the States;
(b) whether the Centre-Region ratio for
the North Eastern Region should be 90:10
against the present ratio of 75:25; and
(c) if so, what are the Government's
views on this?
Exemption from budgetary allocation
for NER
1185. SHRI DRUPAD BORGOHAIN:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) which Ministries have been exempted
from obligatory allocation of 10 per cent of
their budgets to North Eastern Region;
(b) the total amount in the non-lapsable
pool upto 31st March, 2002 and the amount
added during the current year; and
(c) the Government's plan for the
development of North-East?
Progress of disinvestment in ITDC
hotels
1186. SHRI GAYA SINGH: Will the
Minister of DISINVESTMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) how far the efforts of Government to
disinvest for sale or leasing out the hotels
run by ITDC has progressed;
(b) the amount of money realised by
disinvestment of hotels;
(c) the number of hotels sold out and the
amount of money realised through this
process; and
(d) the number of hotels which were
leased out and on what terms?

WIN2\SESSION\2270RS.PM5 265
Disinvestment of PSUs
1187. SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the public sector
undertakings in which disinvestment has
been effected during the years 2001-2002
and 2002-2003;
(b) the percentage of the equity which
has been disinvested in each PSU and total
amount collected by Government in each
case; and
(c) the proposal being considered for
the disinvestment during the current year?
Delay in disinvestment of ITDC
1188. SHRI  MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the disinvestment process
of India Tourism Development Corporation
has again been delayed;
(b) if so, the main reasons for the same;
(c) whether the State Governments
which are equal partners alongwith ITDC
are also keen for the disinvestment;
(d) if so, whether the State Governments
are reluctant to lease out hotel lands; and
(e) if so, by when a final decision
regarding disinvestment process of ITDC
is likely to be taken?
Privatisation plan for Air India and
Indian Airlines
1189. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the privatisation
plans for Air India and Indian Airlines have
been shelved by Government; and
(b) if so, the reasons for this and the
impact it has on the overall Government's
disinvestment plans?
Performance of privatised PSUs
1190. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of DISINVESTMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the privatised Public Sector
Units have improved their performance after
disinvestment;
(b) if so, the current performance of the
privatised public sector enterprises in terms
of their annual turnover, profit and protected
employment; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Utilisation of disinvestment funds
1191. SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the purpose for which funds received
from disinvestment of ITDC hotels were
spent; and
(b) the details of amount spent for rural
development, poverty alleviation,
modernisation of public sector enterprises
and repaying of loans?
Achievement of disinvestment
target

be pleased to state:
